mina: Heads up — SOC wants a forensic extract of auth+proxy logs for an incident. They asked for 21 days but we should limit raw exposure. Proposal: provide full-indexed metadata for 21d but only hand over raw payloads for a 48h window. Use kms-proxy for unwrap and a timeboxed role. Thoughts?

diego: sounds reasonable. One ask: ensure the request ticket includes `purpose`, `scope`, and `must-delete-by` fields. We should auto-verify the delete job ran.

ops-bot: export-job-requirements: ticket_id, requester_email, scope=auth,proxy, raw_window_start, raw_window_end, approver, mfa_present. Missing any will reject.

mina: example ticket: ticket_id=FOR-2026-77, requester=zoe@redwood.com, scope=auth,proxy, metadata-window=2026-03-01/2026-03-21, raw-window=2026-03-10/2026-03-12, retention_raw_hours=48, approver=sec-eng.

sec-eng: add controls: 1) kms:Decrypt only allowed to role/sa=kms-proxy with Condition kms:RequestTag/ticket = "FOR-2026-77"; 2) raw S3 path is encrypted and ACL denies GetObject to humans; 3) deletion job must emit audit event with sha256 and actor.

legal: if data touches EU identities we need legal signoff for any raw export >24h. Policy reminder.

diego: ok we'll add a rule: if raw_window length >24h then require `legal.approved=true` tag on ticket. Also require scrub pipeline run that either `PASSED` or `BLOCKED`. If BLOCKED, raw remains sealed until sec+legal review.

mina: implementing: infra will produce two artifacts: s3://forensics/<ticket>/index.json.gpg (metadata) and s3://forensics/<ticket>/raw/ (encrypted, only kms-proxy can decrypt). Post-export: run `scrub-check --ticket FOR-2026-77` and write attest to s3://forensics/<ticket>/attest/attest.sig. Deletion job runs at TTL and writes audit sink.

ops-bot: note: retention lifecycles: raw TTL=72h, attest TTL=30d, index TTL=365d. All actions logged to audit-sink.

sec-eng: final items: require IAM change PR for new `forensics_exporter` and `forensics_requester` roles, and update runbook with manual approval flow + console audit link. ping me on PR.

mina: will open PR with sample IAM policy and a sample ticket template. Closing unless objections. :lock:
